justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/build/AbstractOrigin.java and the related tests src/test/java/org/apache/commons/io/build/AbstractRandomAccessFileOriginTest.java, RandomAccessFileOriginTest.java, and IORandomAccessFileOriginTest.java. The target is an internal nested abstract base with only two concrete production subclasses in the same file (IORandomAccessFileOrigin and RandomAccessFileOrigin) and one abstract test base plus one concrete test subclass; a repo search found no broader use outside this small hierarchy. Its methods depend on several I/O helpers, but the incoming dependency count is low, so it does not show hub-like high fan-in/high fan-out behavior.
